brief:
The Gaza genocide has claimed numerous artists, poets, filmmakers, educators and musicians among its victims, according to Middle East Eye. Despite the scale of destruction and loss of life, cultural expression continues across the enclave as Palestinians maintain practices tied to their identity and heritage.

Creative communities in Gaza have documented resilience through art, music and performance amid ongoing conflict. Artists, musicians and performers continue working to preserve Palestinian cultural life in the territory.

title: Gaza's cultural figures resist erasure despite Israeli assault
